# SpecScore Studio

> SpecScore Studio offers agent skills and a browser workspace for the open SpecScore specification format.

- [Home](https://specscore.studio/): Agent workflow and browser workspace.
- [Tech stack](https://specscore.studio/about/tech-stack/): Marketing site, agent skills, format, CLI, and separate browser app.
- [Browser workspace](https://specscore.studio/app/): Browse specifications in GitHub repositories.
- [SpecScore format](https://specscore.md/): Open specification format and documentation.
